_comment: Hot-path criterion baseline. Numbers from 2026-05-19 post-fix run on Linux aarch64 sandbox, except `ring/push_ref_pop_ref_tick`: the Apple M4 Pro — 2.53 ns on 2026-09-24 (ZC pass A: the in-place ring API replaced the by-value `ring/push_pop_tick`, 5.25 ns on the sandbox), re-baselined 2026-09-25 to 2.99 ns when core-ring started caching the other side's index (docs/risk-policy.md): +0.5 ns same-core for the private indices, the two-thread round trip 170 -> ~105 ns. Each entry: median ns. Re-baseline by running `make bench` and updating this file when the regression is intentional (e.g. a new feature on the hot path).
